page.layout: One printed page, single text column; running head at top with page number 169 at right; a handwritten number 265 in the top right corner is not printed. Heading "CAPUT X." centred, followed by an italic summary block; body text below. No margin notes.

main_text.p: certum est quicquid inde arripit & infert Ver-nantius, naturalem esse consecutionem, cui nemo ratione præditus refragari debebat: at quæcunque inferunt Sorbonistæ ex illis hypothesibus pugnantia esse & ἀδύνατα; tum meré paralogismos & consequentis fallacias.
main_text.head: CAPUT X.

p.i: Transubstantiationem, purgatorium, cultum imaginum & reliquas ejusdem farinæ Doctrinas Romanenses, suam non habere authoritatem apud Reges; Principes & populos, imo nec apud clerum ab Ecclesia Romana, nec à Paparum Sanctitate vitæ & Doctrinæ, sed ab imperio Papali, suâ potentiâ, divitiis & fulgore, aut terrorem, aut amorem conciliante.

main_text.p: SÆpe admiratio subit me, quî fiat quod tot viri in Ecclesia Romana, etiam ingenii à natura meliore luto formati, vinculo adeo arcto, alligati sint, tum Pontificibus Romanis quæ fuit, hominum generatio maximam partem vitæ impuræ & ad omnia vitia & scelepa projectæ, impuritate ipsos Tiberios, Neronès, Domitianos, Heliogabalos provocavit, tum Religioni Romanæ quæ semper fuit aut causa aut fomes malorum, hæresium, schismatum & bellorum, quibus per plura secula totus orbis Christianus conflagravit. Cujus dogmata ubi abeunt à Protestantibus eorumque placitis congeries est impietatum & absurditatum non

page.notes: Handwritten "265" at top right is not printed. The initial S of "SÆpe" is a large woodcut-style initial, joined to the word. Greek "ἀδύνατα" transcribed as printed in the scan; the letters are uncertain. "scelepa" contains a possibly Cyrillic-looking character in the scan; check. Catchword "non" at bottom right is the last word of the page, treated as text continuation rather than a catchword. Page ends mid-sentence; the final paragraph continues onto the next page.
